purpose: Pre-P1-008 runtime-evidence contract only. Defines deterministic evidence required after P1-007 PASS; does not authorize multi-car implementation.

required_checks.requirement: A vehicle whose visible longitudinal swept corridor is blocked must not change pose after a gameplay tap.
Every sampled collision body during an authorized move remains inside the same visible swept corridor used by the legal-move rule until the visible exit boundary is crossed.
For identical Level Data and state, runtime and independent solver return the same legal/illegal decision.
The prototype must preserve the accepted single-car motion/audio grammar; automated evidence may detect regressions but cannot grant human-quality acceptance.

forbidden_shortcuts: hidden blocker geometry not represented by visible Level Data
numeric PASS treated as human game-quality PASS
